en_title: Gangland Tales From the Frontline of Rockstar's Real-Life Grand Theft Auto Research
cn_title: Rockstar《侠盗猎车手》现实取材前线的黑帮见闻
opus_summary: Rockstar前研究员Gregory Johnson讲述了为《侠盗猎车手5》和《GTA6》开展实地研究的经历，包括随警察巡访洛杉矶帮派社区、采访走私者及乘直升机考察。Johnson称，部分走私者访谈可能为《GTA Online》的佩里科岛抢劫任务提供了素材。

paragraphs.en: Gregory Johnson was sitting in the back of a police car, but he wasn’t under arrest. In fact, the cops were just as nervous as him. Johnson, an experienced researcher for Rockstar, was scouting the underbelly of Los Angeles for Grand Theft Auto 5, an open-world crime game set in a fictionalized L.A. called Los Santos, which is Spanish for “The Saints.” Outside the car window, there were no saints to be found.
paragraphs.cn: Gregory Johnson坐在一辆警车后座上，但他并没有被捕。事实上，警察和他一样紧张。Johnson是Rockstar一名经验丰富的研究员，当时正在为《侠盗猎车手5》考察洛杉矶的阴暗面。这是一款开放世界犯罪游戏，背景设在以洛杉矶为原型虚构的城市Los Santos，西班牙语意为「圣徒」。车窗外，却看不到任何圣徒。

paragraphs.en: “We were doing a ride along in East L.A., very late at night,” Johnson told IGN in a recent interview. “It's still an active gang neighborhood where stuff is going down, so I'm knowing all the signs and seeing a lot of it, and I was super nervous about it. I was like, ‘We're probably okay, but what if we're not?’”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们深夜在东洛杉矶随警巡逻，」Johnson在最近接受IGN采访时说，「那里仍是一个帮派活跃、时有事端发生的街区，所以我认识所有那些迹象，也看到了不少，当时特别紧张。我心想：『我们大概不会有事，但万一有事呢？』」

paragraphs.en: As the car pulled a corner, a whistle cried out from a nearby rooftop. Another series of whistles quickly followed, fading as they moved along a human daisy chain — an alarm system from a series of rooftop sentries to warn other gang members cops were on the prowl. With that, a couple of bikes shot down alleyways, pedalling fast to catch up before pulling up either side of the car to escort it on its patrol through the neighbourhood. The riders stared into the windows through masks.
paragraphs.cn: 车子转过一个街角时，附近的屋顶上传来一声哨响。紧接着又响起一连串哨声，沿着由人组成的接力链传递，逐渐远去——这是屋顶上一系列哨兵发出的警报，提醒其他帮派成员警察正在巡逻。随后，两辆自行车冲进小巷，飞快蹬车追了上来，然后停在车子两侧，护送它穿过街区巡逻。骑车人戴着面罩，盯着车窗里面。

paragraphs.en: “The Mexican gangs of Los Angeles are known to be very organized,” Johnson explained. “And I quickly got to the point where I was like, I know we've got police with us. I know they're armed. The logic of the moment holds that nobody wants this to turn into any situation. They don't want to generally initiate violence with the police. We don't want violence. We're just here to get a feel for the place and maybe poke our long lenses out of the windows and shoot some pictures.
paragraphs.cn: 「洛杉矶的墨西哥帮派以组织严密著称，」Johnson解释道，「我很快就想，跟我们在一起的是警察，我知道他们带着枪。按照当时的情形来推断，谁都不想把事情闹大。他们一般不想主动对警察动武，我们也不想发生暴力。我们只是来感受一下这个地方，也许把长焦镜头伸出窗外拍些照片。

paragraphs.en: “So we just got through it and ran our routes, and got everybody back to the hotel safely, but once I saw the neighborhood activate… I mean, it's amazing to see if you're going to try and duplicate it with the gameplay, right? But when you're actually in it, you're like, ‘This could go bad.’”
paragraphs.cn: 「所以我们就这样挺了过来，走完了巡逻路线，把所有人安全带回了酒店。但当我看到整个街区行动起来……我是说，如果你打算在游戏玩法中重现这一幕，看到它确实很棒，对吧？但当你真的身处其中时，你会想：『事情可能会变糟。』」

paragraphs.en: Even that feeling is important — the dread, the worry that things could boil over at any moment — when trying to capture the essence of a city, from its decadent hilltop houses in the Hollywood Hills to its low-income neighbourhoods over the Los Angeles River. Mood is a hard thing to capture unless you’ve felt the electricity in the air yourself as fight or flight kicks in and the hairs on the back of your neck stand to attention.
paragraphs.cn: 在试图捕捉一座城市的本质时，即便是那种感觉也很重要——那种恐惧，那种担心事态随时可能失控的心情——从Hollywood Hills山顶上奢靡的住宅，到Los Angeles River另一边的低收入街区，都是如此。氛围很难捕捉，除非你亲身感受过空气中那种紧张气息，体验过战斗或逃跑反应启动、后颈汗毛竖起的感觉。

paragraphs.en: “I had to keep everybody cool in the group,” Johnson, a Floridian who lived most of his life in New York, remembered. “We've got a bunch of guys from Scotland and England, Ireland. Never seen anything like it. They're like, ‘Is everything okay, Greg?’ ‘Yeah, everything's fine.’ Completely lying. ‘Everything's fine, guys.’ It was somewhere between location scouting and espionage.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我得让团队里的每个人保持冷静，」Johnson回忆道。他是佛罗里达人，一生中大部分时间住在纽约。「我们有一帮来自苏格兰、英格兰和爱尔兰的家伙。他们从没见过这种场面。他们问：『一切都好吗，Greg？』『是啊，一切都好。』完全是在撒谎。『一切都好，伙计们。』这介于实地勘景和谍报活动之间。」

paragraphs.en: Johnson himself knew the streets fairly well already, but he was partly recruited not just because of what he knew, but because of who he knew. Having worked on hip-hop’s Vibe Magazine for 16 years, as well as other prestigious music mags like Source, he was already embedded in the culture. He knew the people in the music industry Rockstar was working with, and helped make introductions where he could. He had his finger pushed hard into the pulse of an ever-shifting culture.
paragraphs.cn: Johnson本人已经相当熟悉街头，但他之所以被招募，部分原因不仅在于他的知识，还在于他认识的人。他曾在嘻哈杂志《Vibe Magazine》工作16年，也曾为《Source》等其他知名音乐杂志工作，早已融入这种文化。他认识Rockstar合作的音乐行业人士，并尽可能从中牵线搭桥。他紧紧把握着一种不断变化的文化的脉搏。

paragraphs.en: “Dan Houser had a vision for a professional research team that could easily deliver academic information,” Johnson explained. “Basically an internal form of reporting, cultural research. The role grew right as we established the department, but he had tried to get together various versions of it, and when he hired me and a couple other people around that time, I had an academic background as well as a background in hip hop journalism, and I knew the culture inside and out. We would go through tons of pop culture and various applicable subcultures.
paragraphs.cn: 「Dan Houser希望建立一支能够轻松提供学术信息的专业研究团队，」Johnson解释道，「基本上就是一种内部报道形式，进行文化研究。随着我们建立这个部门，这一职能也随之发展起来，但他此前曾尝试组建过不同版本的团队。在他于那段时间雇用我和另外几个人时，我既有学术背景，也有嘻哈新闻报道的背景，对这种文化了如指掌。我们会研究大量流行文化和各种相关的亚文化。

paragraphs.en: “Rockstar has represented Jamaican yardies extremely well. The mafia culture in GTA, the Yakuza culture in GTA — all of these different subcultures and themes were really rich targets for deep dives. The better the graphics got, the better the gameplay got, the better the voiceovers got — the ambient stuff, the missions — the more background information was required to distill it into these memorable, immersive gameplay experiences. We did real life research, and these broad surveys of popular culture and the popular imagination, depending on the setting of the game, the timing of the game, and the artistic and creative direction.”
paragraphs.cn: 「Rockstar对牙买加帮派的呈现非常出色。《侠盗猎车手》中的黑手党文化、《侠盗猎车手》中的日本黑帮文化——所有这些不同的亚文化和主题都非常值得深入研究。随着画面越来越好、游戏玩法越来越好、配音越来越好——还有环境内容、任务——要将其提炼成这些令人难忘、身临其境的游戏体验，就需要更多背景信息。我们会根据游戏的设定、时间背景以及艺术和创作方向，进行现实调查，并广泛研究流行文化和大众想象。」

paragraphs.en: At one point, a smuggler came across Rockstar’s radar. This was a guy who knew the late drug lord Pablo Escobar personally and was a major player in the Cocaine Cowboys era, the Scarface days, when the Medellin Cartel trafficked white powder into Miami through the ‘70s and ‘80s. According to Johnson, some of the interviews with the smuggler likely informed the Cayo Perico heist in GTA Online.
paragraphs.cn: 有一段时间，一名走私犯进入了Rockstar的视野。此人认识已故毒枭Pablo Escobar本人，也是Cocaine Cowboys时代、《疤面煞星》时期的重要人物，当时Medellin Cartel在上世纪70至80年代将白色粉末贩运到迈阿密。Johnson表示，对这名走私犯的部分采访很可能为《GTA Online》中的Cayo Perico抢劫任务提供了素材。

paragraphs.en: “This was one of the guys that helped the Colombians figure out their underwater submersible system, where they were, with submarines of various quality, able to bring stuff from the Colombian coast into the U.S.,” Johnson said. “That later changed. The Colombian cartels ended up cutting a deal with the Mexican cartels. But this guy was from the era when they were still getting it into the United States directly.”
paragraphs.cn: 「这家伙是帮助哥伦比亚人搞定水下潜航器系统的人之一，他们用质量参差不齐的潜艇，把东西从哥伦比亚海岸运到美国，」Johnson说，「后来情况变了。哥伦比亚贩毒集团最终与墨西哥贩毒集团达成了协议。但这家伙所处的时代，他们还在直接把东西运进美国。」

paragraphs.en: The drug runner told Rockstar stories about having to pay tribute to Pablo Escobar, and the time he got kidnapped by another cartel member and held in a dingy room god-knows-where, wondering if he would be killed. His stories gave the research team a peek behind the curtain of organized crime arguably at its height. But even talking to him — despite strict NDAs protecting identities — came with its own concerns.
paragraphs.cn: 这名毒贩向Rockstar讲述了自己不得不向Pablo Escobar进贡的故事，还讲到他曾被另一名贩毒集团成员绑架，关在天知道什么地方的一间昏暗房间里，不知道自己会不会被杀。他的故事让研究团队得以一窥有组织犯罪可以说最鼎盛时期的幕后。但即使只是和他交谈——尽管有严格的保密协议保护身份——也有令人担忧之处。

paragraphs.en: “Just hanging out with this guy and his sidekick in Miami, it occurred to me that revenge could visit him at any moment,” Johnson said with a nervous laugh. “And they're not going to distinguish.”
paragraphs.cn: 「只是在迈阿密和这家伙及他的同伴待在一起，我就想到，复仇可能随时会找上他，」Johnson紧张地笑着说，「而他们不会分辨谁是谁。」

paragraphs.en: Some of the most intense encounters weren’t one-off meetings — they were in the studio where Rockstar recorded its motion capture and voice lines. Radio DJ turned writer Lazlow, Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser, and director of production Rod Edge were exposed to these the most as they ensured words on the script survived the transition to audio files.
paragraphs.cn: 一些最紧张的接触并非一次性会面——它们发生在Rockstar录制动作捕捉和语音台词的工作室里。电台DJ出身的编剧Lazlow、Rockstar联合创始人Dan Houser以及制作总监Rod Edge接触这些人的机会最多，他们负责确保剧本上的文字在转化为音频文件的过程中得以保留。

paragraphs.en: “DJ Poo and Estevan Oriol and Mister Cartoon were bringing real gangsters,” Johnson explained. “Some of these guys are famous for bringing these guys in for bit parts and minor roles in some of the L.A. street films. It's like the Sopranos where Tony Sirico is a former Gambino associate, and he ended up getting a recurring role as Paulie Walnuts. Or The Wire, which was another television program that was a huge influence on me and Rockstar, to varying degrees. The Wire was known for bringing people out of the Baltimore streets and giving them roles on the show — ‘Snoop’ Pearson, Nathan Barksdale, and a few other legit Baltimore gangsters.
paragraphs.cn: 「DJ Poo、Estevan Oriol和Mister Cartoon会带真正的帮派成员来，」Johnson解释道，「这些人当中有些人以把这些家伙带进一些洛杉矶街头题材电影、让他们出演小角色和配角而出名。就像《黑道家族》，托尼·西里科曾是Gambino犯罪家族的关联人员，后来他获得了Paulie Walnuts这个经常出场的角色。还有《火线》，这是另一部对我和Rockstar都产生了不同程度巨大影响的电视剧。《火线》以让巴尔的摩街头的人参演而闻名——『Snoop』Pearson、Nathan Barksdale，还有其他几个真正的巴尔的摩帮派成员。

paragraphs.en: “So we would do a lot of that stuff. Some of these guys are like Salvadorian gangsters with a face full of tattoos, and you're like, ‘Say this line again with more enthusiasm.’ Or they'll tell you, ‘Check this out, bro. We wouldn't say that like that. We say this like this.’ So even though we would try to do a ton of research and make the scripts as authentic as possible, somebody that's lived that life is going to have the most current, up to date jargon and slang and lingo. A lot of them were just super excited to have their horizons opened, and get an opportunity to do voiceover work.”
paragraphs.cn: 「所以我们会经常这样做。这些人里有些是满脸纹身的萨尔瓦多帮派成员，而你会对他们说：『再把这句台词说一遍，热情一点。』或者他们会告诉你：『听着，兄弟。我们不会那么说。我们是这么说的。』所以即使我们会努力做大量研究，让剧本尽可能真实，真正过过那种生活的人还是掌握着最新、最时髦的行话、俚语和用语。他们中的许多人都特别兴奋，因为这开阔了他们的眼界，也给了他们从事配音工作的机会。」

paragraphs.en: It wasn’t all fear, either. When Johnson worked on GTA 6 , the research team took a helicopter from Miami to Key West, flying low over the barrier islands with a long lens — Johnson never imagined he’d see the city and its surrounding areas like this. Sometimes up-close, sometimes a bird’s-eye view, always documenting and capturing the vibe to bottle up and digitize, top to bottom, micro and macro — this authenticity and obsessive attention to detail is what makes Rockstar open-worlds feel so alive.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，也不全是恐惧。Johnson参与《GTA6》开发时，研究团队乘直升机从迈阿密飞往Key West，带着长焦镜头低空飞过一座座屏障岛——Johnson从未想过自己会以这种方式看到这座城市及其周边地区。有时近距离观察，有时从空中俯瞰，始终记录和捕捉当地氛围，将其收集起来并数字化，从上到下，从微观到宏观——这种真实感和对细节近乎痴迷的关注，让Rockstar的开放世界显得如此鲜活。

paragraphs.en: “There was a ton of stuff,” Johnson said. “I would visit the prisons. They were nervous but hilarious. It was our job to give the developers the exposure they needed to any one of these areas of the game, whether it was the underworld stuff or street racers, or whatever. Anything we could do to make the experience more immersive and authentic, like sitting down with FBI agents or gangsters or working as location scouts. Basically we had a broad mandate, and I think we did a pretty good job of it.”
paragraphs.cn: 「有很多事情，」Johnson说，「我会去探访监狱。那些经历让人紧张，但也很有趣。我们的工作是让开发者接触他们所需了解的游戏各个方面，无论是地下世界的事情、街头赛车手，还是别的什么。凡是能让体验更有沉浸感、更真实的事情，我们都会做，比如和FBI探员或帮派成员坐下来交谈，或者担任外景勘察员。基本上，我们的职责范围很广，我认为我们做得相当不错。」

paragraphs.en: The extreme lengths Rockstar developers go to in the aim of creating authentic worldsare partly why there’s such a buzz behind GTA 6, which has already generated $1 billion in preorder sales . No one does it like Rockstar, and the audience knows this.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar开发者为创造真实世界而付出的巨大努力，是《GTA6》引发如此热议的部分原因。这款游戏的预购销售额已经达到10亿美元。没有人能像Rockstar一样做到这一点，玩家也知道。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar recently spoke about its GTA 6 research trips (some of which Johnson attended — he left the company halfway through development). It’s where every game starts, but the process continues throughout development to keep the writers and designers keyed into the culture of the place they’re basing the game world on. The company even built out an entire studio just to write dialogue for pedestrian NPCs, such is its commitment to the craft of making a living simulation.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar最近谈到了《GTA6》的实地考察之旅（Johnson参与了其中一些——他在开发进行到一半时离开了公司）。每款游戏都从这里开始，但这一过程会贯穿整个开发周期，让编剧和设计师持续了解游戏世界原型所在地的文化。公司甚至专门建立了一整个工作室，只为给路人NPC编写对话，其对打造鲜活模拟世界这一技艺的投入可见一斑。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 launches on November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于11月19日登陆PS5、XBOX Series X和S。
